Before you order

Important ordering guidelines & policies

Build your burrito

Choose your fillings from the menu. The minimum order value is Tk 250. A full burrito with all fillings is Tk 400.

Confirm your order

Send your selections, quantity, name, and phone number by message. Your order is confirmed after Pico replies.

Delivery & pickup

Delivery is available in selected areas. Share your exact location so we can confirm the delivery charge and timing.

Changes & cancellations

Please request changes or cancellations before preparation begins. Prepared orders cannot be changed or refunded.
